# `Q-5-41` — Page Is Not Part of the Book

> A page that is not in the book's chapter list was rendered on its own.

## What this means

A book renders to a single document (typst, pdf and epub) from the files
listed in `book.chapters`. The page you asked for is in the project but is
not in that list, so there is no place for it in the book. Quarto renders it
as a standalone document and tells you, rather than refusing or silently
rendering a different file.

Asking for the page alone (`--book-scope chapter`) does not show this notice.

## How to fix

If the page belongs in the book, list it:

```yaml
book:
  chapters:
    - index.qmd
    - notes.qmd
```

If it is meant to be standalone, no action is needed.
